scope.claim: bounded comparison; not systematic or exhaustive

sources.name: SymPy lie_group
sources.source_statement: The module computes infinitesimals and reductions for first-order scalar ODEs using named heuristics; it rejects multiple independent variables and orders other than one.
sources.comparison: ODE-only control for bounded ansatze, coefficient maps, cancellation, and canonical-coordinate reduction; not a PDE-system implementation.
limitations: Heuristic search stops after successes unless all heuristics are requested

sources.name: dpack 0.1.0.1
sources.license_evidence: README states copyright and no warranty but contains no permission grant
sources.source_statement: The inspected source prolongs generators, solves for leading derivatives, substitutes onto the solution manifold, normalizes numerators, rationalizes in jet variables, and extracts distributed polynomial coefficients; Janet/LPDE routines are present.
sources.comparison: Direct PDE determining-equation comparator with broader differential-system machinery.

sources.name: ReLie
sources.license_evidence: Author page says source is downloadable and paper says freely available; no explicit software license was found in relie.red or the ZIP.
sources.source_statement: ReLie uses explicit leading derivatives, numerator normalization, recursive coefficient extraction, a nonpolyders list excluded from polynomial splitting, and CRACK for determining-system integration.
sources.comparison: Strong method lead for conservative nonpolynomial handling and staged integration.

sources.name: SADE
sources.source_statement: The paper describes orthonomic reduction, splitting over independent derivatives, staged solution of overdetermined systems, selective rifsimp/Kolchin-Ritt completion, and invariant reduction; see especially PDF pp. 15-17.
sources.comparison: Direct PDE workflow and solver-architecture evidence; not code-inspected.

sources.name: Maple PDEtools
sources.source_statement: Public help documents infinitesimal computation for PDE systems, invariant solutions, and case splitting with integrability conditions.
sources.comparison: Confirms workflow capabilities but exposes no implementation algorithm.

sources.name: Lie-Symmetries
sources.source_statement: The code builds degree-bounded polynomial infinitesimals for rational ODE models, separates numerators and denominators, extracts coefficients, and computes a nullspace.
sources.comparison: Useful bounded-ansatz and sparse-linear-algebra reference; not a PDE classifier.
limitations: GPL-3.0 compatibility must be decided before reuse

sources.name: GeM
sources.source_statement: Crossref/OpenAlex identify a Maple package for computation of symmetries and conservation laws of differential equations.
sources.comparison: Scope-only comparator; no implementation claim made.
limitations: Full text unavailable in bounded retrieval

sources.name: DESOLV
sources.source_statement: Crossref/OpenAlex identify the paper Similarity solutions of partial differential equations using DESOLV by Vu, Butcher, and Carminati.
sources.comparison: Directly relevant reduction scope, but no implementation-level comparison is supported.
limitations: OpenAlex reported no open full text
SADE benchmark statements were not rerun
